name: Acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2)
aliases: Acute myeloid leukemia with MECOM rearrangement

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues (2022)

criteria.description: Presence of inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2) cytogenetic abnormality detected by karyotyping or FISH
Bone marrow or peripheral blood blasts ≥20%
Morphologic evidence of myeloid lineage blasts with dysplastic features
Detection of MECOM gene rearrangement by molecular methods

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2) cytogenetic abnormality plus ≥20% myeloid blasts in bone marrow or peripheral blood
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of cytogenetic, morphologic, and blast count criteria per WHO guidelines.

pathognomonic.notes: Severe platelet reduction leading to mucocutaneous bleeding
searchTerms: very low platelets with bleeding risk
bleeding tendency due to low platelets

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hypercellular bone marrow with abnormal megakaryocytes
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic marrow morphology associated with inv(3)/t(3;3)
searchTerms: bone marrow crowded with abnormal megakaryocytes
hypercellular marrow with abnormal platelet cells

common.symptomName: Anemia-related pallor and dyspnea on exertion
searchTerms: pale skin and shortness of breath

common.notes: Increased susceptibility to bacterial and fungal infections
searchTerms: recurrent infections due to immune weakness
infections caused by low white blood cells

common.symptomName: Bone pain secondary to marrow expansion
searchTerms: aching bones due to marrow growth
losing weight and sweating at night

occasional.notes: Liver enlargement due to leukemic infiltration

searchTerms: small red or purple skin spots

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement with cranial neuropathies

rare.notes: Due to high circulating blast counts
searchTerms: lung problems from blood cell buildup

rare.notes: Metabolic complications from rapid cell turnover
searchTerms: chemical imbalance from cancer cell death
tumor lysis causing kidney and electrolyte problems

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing circulating myeloblasts
imaging: Chest X-ray may show pulmonary infiltrates in leukostasis
other: Bone marrow biopsy showing hypercellularity with dysplastic megakaryocytes

redFlags: Signs of leukostasis such as respiratory distress or neurological deficits
references: Arber DA, et al. The 5th edition of the WHO Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours: Myeloid and Histiocytic/Dendritic Neoplasms. Leukemia. 2022.
Swerdlow SH, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
